Each question is expanded into three, searched in parallel, reranked by an LLM, and answered only from the top five chunks. Built with JavaScript, LangChain, Pinecone, RAG, Embeddings. upload → chunk 800 / overlap 150 · embed all-MiniLM-L6-v2 → Pinecone · 1 question → 3 queries · top 5 each → LLM rerank · ✓ answers from the top 5 chunks
